newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 80 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 80 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 80-billion-bolivar auction of 179-, 269- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 31.48 percent.
The bank said it would offer 50 billion bolivars worth of 179-day bills at a rate of 29.34 percent and 15 billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 30.39 percent.
At its auction last week, the Central Bank sold 90 billion bolivars worth of 173-, 262- and 351-day bills with yields of 30.66 percent, 31.79 percent and 32.99 percent, respectively.
